headline: The compiled "472 RC" registration guidelines approved (the document this Desk is built on); scrutiny templates finalised; health-monitoring protocol for household products; States may endorse "Marketed by"; export-permit guidelines for dual-use products.

changes.d: The sub-committee's compilation of all RC guidelines with specific conditions was approved. Data for biopesticides and botanicals will be accepted from NABL-approved labs. This is the "472 RC guidelines" document used in this Desk.
Templates/proformas for scrutiny of each registration category, revised after stakeholder meetings on 06.03.2026 and 08.05.2026, were approved.

changes.t: Health monitoring protocol for household products
changes.d: A standard Health Monitoring Study protocol (Annexure 10.51.1) is adopted so studies can start in parallel and finish sooner; a public notice will follow.
State Governments may endorse marketing agencies under "Marketed by" on the label, following the prescribed procedure (461st RC decision reiterated).
Registration is valid all over India; a State manufacturing licence covers production, and dealer sale licences are separate.
Guidelines, checklist and application form approved for export permits of multi-use / non-insecticidal products, with IUPAC name, CAS no., Schedule serial no. and geo-tagging of premises.

changes.t: Unfreezing CROP accounts without any certificate
changes.d: Firms that only created an account (no CR or permit) need not give a State verification letter; other documentary proof of the firm is enough.
Interim approval for synthetic pyrethroids in IRS against sand flies extended one year. Ad-hoc approval of Dimethoate 30% EC on tea extended one year or until registration.
Chlorothalonil TI-New Source rejected (source not on ICAMA website); Moti Insecticides' Pendimethalin TIM rejected (higher impurity in CIL report).
Show-cause/presentation on a forged Sulphur 80% WDG certificate.

actions: Use the compiled 472 RC guidelines and the new scrutiny templates for every application.
Household products: use the new health monitoring protocol.
Marketers: get the "Marketed by" endorsement from the State.
